summary: Bangkok DTV visa service run by a Muay Thai school, offering Muay Thai enrolment letters and application review packages.

facts.label: DTV support
facts.value: DTV visa service in Bangkok backed by a Muay Thai school that issues the enrolment letter
facts.quote: FITFAC runs a DTV visa service in Bangkok from its Sathorn office.
